entry: Golden cross: go long when the 50 MA crosses above the 200 MA.
If the crossover entry would need a stop far from price, wait for a pullback to the moving averages before entering.
Death cross (short): after the 50 MA crosses below the 200 MA, wait for price to reject the level with a bearish candle.
exit: Exit when the moving averages cross back the other way, or alternatively on a close back beyond the 200 MA.
stop_loss: Long: stop below the previous lows. Short: stop above the previous highs (no fixed distance given).
filters: Optional confirmation: RSI above 50 supports a bullish signal.
Optional confirmation: MACD (12, 26, 9) line/signal crossover in the trade direction.
